---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem it solves

What user pain point does this address? Why does it matter?

## Proposed solution

A clear description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches did you think about, and why did you pick this one?

## Scope check

This project is intentionally **local-first** (no servers, no telemetry, no
accounts, no commercial features). Confirm the proposed feature fits that scope:

- [ ] No server / cloud component
- [ ] No account / login
- [ ] No telemetry
- [ ] Commercial-neutral (no ads, no premium tier)

If any box is unchecked, please explain why the project scope should be
expanded for this feature.

## Effort

If you can, give a rough sense of the size of the change:

- [ ] Small (one file, < 100 lines)
- [ ] Medium (a few files, < 500 lines)
- [ ] Large (architectural change)

## Will you open a PR?

- [ ] Yes, I'd like to implement this
- [ ] No, I'm just suggesting
- [ ] Maybe, depending on feedback
